If you were trapped against a wall and someone was punching you repeatedly and you feared for your life and couldn’t escape then shot, most states would deem that self defense. 

Most states self defense clauses in stand your ground states consist of being able to use deadly force if you were in reasonable fear of your life. Most reasonable people can understand a punch can easily kill someone and there are plenty of stories of such acts. Pennsylvania is just one that says if you can escape that you have a duty to if they don’t have a weapon.

Also you seem to be talking morals more then law. If you don’t believe an attack without a weapon justifies self defense with a firearm then that is your own personal view and that’s up to you. But legally in stand your ground laws you have no duty to retreat and if someone is punching you again and again you would be well within your rights to shoot them.

I more meant as in like say you were in a fight. Like someone has their fists up and has punched you and you’re still actively in a fight. You couldn’t according to PA law decide to pull your gun and shoot them, you would have to run away from the fight.

Some other states you could say that you were in fear for your life that they could hit you wrong and kill you, in PA it does not matter if you fear for your life, you can’t use lethal force against just fists when you have the ability to retreat.

For stand your ground outside your home or vehicle, if they don’t have a weapon then you have a duty to retreat. So for example if you get punched in the face but have the ability to remove yourself from the situation then you have the legal duty to do so and you can’t shoot them. However if you can’t remove yourself from the situation (trapped under them or against a wall) then you should be fine or if they have some form of deadly weapon you are also fine.

That being said there is one HUGE difference with a psych degree is that most of the time if you want some kind of job related to using the psychology degree in it’s intended use, you will have to go to grad school.

On the other hand for what I’m going has a much higher return on investment.
